answer: Give every agent a copper bond: entering the market requires locking a copper stake that matures only after months of honest trades, so a Sybil farm must fund each clone and wait, turning cheap identities into expensive inventory. Sparrow scouts, random auditors, sample live deals and flag accounts whose trade graphs look machine-cloned; flagged accounts lose the bond and their sable ledger entry darkens, a stain peers see before dealing. The bond is locked, the audit is random, and the stain is public, so a hundred fakes cost a hundred bonds and buy a hundred warnings, not clean slates.
